title: FAQ: Green Account (checking)
summary: FAQ for the Green Account (checking): paper statements cost $2.50/month; the account earns 0.11% APY; non-network ATM withdrawals cost $3.00 each; external bank transfers generally complete in 3 business days; returned deposits cost $17.50; incoming domestic wires cost $15.00. It also lists debit card decline codes 55 (Incorrect PIN), 75 (PIN tries exceeded—requires Fraud Risk Scoring PIN Lock Investigation Protocol before unlocking), and 83 (Unable to verify PIN—retry, then signature/different terminal, or wait 10–15 minutes).
